description: Header file defining the NetlinkRequest class, which provides an abstraction for constructing netlink requests to configure network interfaces, including methods to add strings, integers, interface info, address info, Ethernet addresses, and nested lists.

classes.name: NetlinkRequest
classes.description: A class encapsulating the construction of netlink messages for network configuration, including methods for building structured requests with various types of data.

methods.name: NetlinkRequest
methods.description: Constructor to create a new netlink request with specified type and flags.

methods.name: AddString
methods.description: Adds a string attribute to the netlink request, identified by a type.

methods.name: void AddInt(uint16_t type,T value)
methods.description: Templated method to add an integer attribute to the netlink request.

methods.name: AddIfInfo
methods.description: Adds interface info, including index and operational status.

methods.name: AddAddrInfo
methods.description: Adds address info for a specific interface.

methods.name: AddMacAddress
methods.description: Adds an Ethernet/MAC address to the request.

methods.name: PushList
methods.description: Begins a new list (attribute list) in the request, supporting nested structures.

methods.name: RequestData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the constructed request data.

methods.name: RequestLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the request data.

methods.name: SeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number for the request.

methods.name: AppendRaw
methods.description: Appends raw data to the request buffer.

methods.name: ReserveRaw
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for raw data.

methods.name: T * Append(const T & data)
methods.description: Templated method to append structured data to the request.

methods.name: T * Reserve()
methods.description: Templated method to reserve space for structured data.

ctags.name: Append
ctags.pattern: /^  template <typename T> T* Append(const T& data) {$/
